integrity: The argument is self-contained after the cited definition and alternating-link breadth theorem. It uses exact mod-two cochain and cellular-duality reasoning and does not infer an infinite statement from finite computation.
scientific_limitations: The dual-systole and double-cover formulas require a cellular embedding. The link consequence is restricted to diagrams whose checkerboard graphs form a cellular dual pair. No non-alternating Jones inequality is proved.
title: Projective rank is the dual homological systole in the projective plane
